work_completed: Diagnosed Joshua's first real-ML run (the avatar only walked around the world). Cause 1, in neurolift-ai-fusion: both model decision sources (gguf_agent_decision.py, transformers_agent_decision.py) prompt and parse only 'wait' and 'approach', so the AGENT-LOOP-002 verbs could never be chosen. That is fixed in a separate neurolift-ai-fusion PR. Cause 2, here: 'wait' and an untargeted 'rest' handed the avatar back to the wander tour, so a model saying 'stay put' looked like no model at all.
AvatarCharacter.ApplyIntent: 'wait' and 'rest' with no target hold the avatar still (IdleController, last movement dropped) until the next intent; the label shows 'waiting' / 'resting'.

A 'wait' arriving while the avatar walks to a target lets the walk finish (as 'wait' already let an interaction carry on). Without this, Fusion's 2 s cadence would stop the avatar short of every target.
Stale comments in ApplyIntent and on WanderFallback brought in line with what the code does.

CodeRabbit on PR 111: the 'walking to a target' flag survived when sit/use/rest (ApplyInteraction) or a governance halt replaced the walk, so after the interaction every 'wait' was ignored and the avatar wandered. EndInteraction, which every replacement path calls, now clears it. In-engine, approach -> sit -> hold ends -> wait: before, moved 1.12 m in 3 s; after, 0.00 m, labelled 'waiting'.

Spectator peek (Joshua chose it 2026-10-21, after 'when i click on a building it doesn't go to the scene'). WorldView hands a spectator door used while the doors are locked to an overridable SpectatorDoor, and has a ViewNotice drawn by WorldViewHud under the scene strip. Main peeks while the avatar is outdoors: ShowScene for the room, display-only because physics stays with the avatar, and the avatar is hidden. The peek survives per-document ShowLoopAvatarScene. It ends on E/exit or when the avatar changes scene (Transit ends it). With the avatar indoors, doors are refused with a notice, since only one interior instance exists. The camera stops following the avatar while peeking.
work_in_progress: T6 acceptance 4 (model-driven sit/use) still needs Joshua's dev-PC run with the widened Fusion prompt.
decisions_made: Joshua, 2026-10-21: 'wait' holds still instead of wandering (and the Fusion prompt is widened).
Untargeted 'rest' is treated like 'wait' (hold still, labelled resting), matching the existing intent of the verb map's comment.

If an approach stalls against an obstacle (no pathfinding, deferred by Joshua 2026-10-18), a following 'wait' now leaves it pressing against the obstacle rather than wandering off. The model has to choose another target.

Joshua, 2026-10-21: with the loop on, a click on a building peeks inside (view only). That answers the T1 open question 'a refused spectator door is only logged'. Peeking is offered only while the avatar is outdoors, because WorldView holds one interior instance, which must be the avatar's room while it is inside.
